queries_run: Sandisk China export control OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 揭露：國際銷售占淨營收 82%（FY2026），暴露於關稅與貿易法規風險。
findings.excerpt: Our international sales, which include sales to foreign subsidiaries of U.S. companies but do not include sales to U.S. subsidiaries of foreign companies, represented 82%, 80% and 86% of our net revenue for 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

findings.claim: 美國 Section 232 與 301 調查進行中，可能影響關稅；目前在美銷售的多數產品免關稅，若失去豁免或加稅將增加銷貨成本、壓縮毛利。
findings.excerpt: Currently, the majority of our products sold in the U.S. are exempt from tariffs, but additional tariff increases, or the loss of applicable exemptions, would increase the cost of goods sold for our products sold in the U.S., which could negatively impact our margins and financial performance.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：供應商可能因關稅、配額、制裁、禁運等貿易限制而無法供貨，導致成本上升與交期拉長。
findings.excerpt: Trade restrictions, including tariffs, quotas and embargoes, demand from other high-volume industries for materials or components used in our products, disruptions in supplier relationships or shortages in other components and materials used in our customers’ products could result in increased costs to us, longer lead times, or decreased demand for our products, which could negatively impact our business.

note: 搜尋未找到 SNDK 專屬的出口管制／實體清單事件；Section 232 半導體關稅（2026-01-15 生效）僅針對窄範圍先進晶片，搜尋摘要未提及 SNDK。
